opening.argument: The offer is tied to a clear sequence: visit the speaker’s website, provide a phone number, arrange contact, and set up a Coinbase wallet to receive free Bitcoin. Alongside that pitch, he says he sells Bitcoin mining contracts and describes daily Bitcoin production from a mining operation. He also projects that a few dollars’ worth of Bitcoin could be worth thousands of dollars three to five years later. Taken together, the promised Bitcoin, wallet setup, and promotion of paid mining contracts support the concern that this is a paid mining or node-returns scheme. The available evidence does not establish whether Bitcoin was sent or whether the projected value was realized.
